source.scope: Permanent sortie and expedition quests; only server-listed available/active quests are displayed.
source.rights: Original wiki wording and game names retain their original rights; structured rules are independently implemented. Raw pages are not distributed.
boundaries: Rules are reviewed sufficient-action definitions, not proof of every minimal game requirement.
Goal counts are requirements, never inferred remaining counts or server progress.
No prerequisite inference, task acceptance, completion tracking or limited-time quests.
Ordinary same-name remodels are accepted; renamed or type-converted forms require explicit permission or remain unknown.
